encodings.statement: Pinned pure semantic profile: Rust 1.89.0 core/time.rs, stable functions only; clocks and Tokio sleep require separate checked effects. Duration values are immutable tagged records with own u64 BigInt seconds and normalized u32 BigInt nanoseconds below 1000000000; private fields describe the lowering ABI, not source-level constructor permission. Checked operations return frozen Rust Option values; ordinary operation overflow and invalid float constructors abort as Rust panics, never synthetic successful Results. Source f64 conversions preserve IEEE-754 values and nearest-nanosecond ties-to-even; f32 contracts are omitted until the frontend distinguishes binary32. constEligible means the pinned source declares the function const; pure alone never grants const evaluation to trait or floating constructor methods. Source-derived fixtures establish the adapter subset; Rust differential execution stays gated on complete JavaScript checks.
